target: An AI-native game creation platform that can take a concept to a tested, shippable, maintainable game while retaining deterministic evidence, provenance, security and human control.

capabilities.name: Prompt-to-playable loop
capabilities.build_note: Turn an intent/spec into a runnable vertical slice with a reproducible generation record and repair loop.

capabilities.name: Persistent game design graph
capabilities.build_note: Represent mechanics, assets, scenes, narrative, dependencies and acceptance criteria as a queryable graph rather than chat-only state.

capabilities.name: Parallel multi-agent build orchestration
capabilities.build_note: Claim isolated work units, detect collisions, merge evidence, and keep agents working concurrently without duplicated effort.

capabilities.name: Project memory and context routing
capabilities.build_note: Persist design decisions, source evidence, asset provenance, user constraints and prior failures in scoped retrievable memory.

capabilities.name: Live playable preview
capabilities.build_note: Provide low-latency preview/reload from generated changes with clear rollback boundaries.

capabilities.name: Visual scene and logic editor
capabilities.build_note: Expose scenes, systems and generated logic through inspectable visual tooling, not only generated files.

capabilities.name: Human approval and reversible autonomy
capabilities.build_note: Require explicit approval for high-impact changes and make every autonomous mutation reversible.

capabilities.name: Scene graph and composition
capabilities.build_note: Create, compose, diff and validate scene hierarchies across generated and imported content.

capabilities.name: Terrain and environment generation
capabilities.build_note: Generate editable terrain, biomes, foliage, water and environment dressing with performance budgets.

capabilities.name: Large-world streaming
capabilities.build_note: Stream cells/assets deterministically for large worlds and constrained devices.

capabilities.name: Procedural content generation
capabilities.build_note: Generate worlds/levels with seed control, constraints, diversity metrics and validation.

capabilities.name: Persistent world simulation
capabilities.build_note: Run economic, faction, ecology and schedule simulation independently from rendering with deterministic state transitions.

capabilities.name: Gameplay mechanics synthesis
capabilities.build_note: Generate mechanics from explicit contracts and prove them through deterministic tests rather than prose-only design.

capabilities.name: Entity/component/system runtime
capabilities.build_note: Support scalable composable runtime systems with serialization and deterministic scheduling.

capabilities.name: Safe gameplay scripting
capabilities.build_note: Provide generated gameplay scripting with capability permissions, resource limits, validation and hot reload.

capabilities.name: Input and device abstraction
capabilities.build_note: Unify keyboard/mouse/touch/gamepad mappings and accessibility remaps across targets.

capabilities.name: Save/state migration
capabilities.build_note: Version game state, migrate saves safely, and test backward/forward compatibility.

capabilities.name: Agentic NPCs
capabilities.build_note: Combine bounded memory, goals, schedules, perception, dialogue and action with latency/cost/safety budgets.

capabilities.name: Interactive dialogue generation
capabilities.build_note: Generate context-aware dialogue with canonical facts, branching constraints, moderation and deterministic fallback.

capabilities.name: Narrative planning
capabilities.build_note: Maintain arcs, pacing, canon and consequence graphs while permitting controlled emergence.

capabilities.name: Quest/objective generation
capabilities.build_note: Generate solvable quests with prerequisites, rewards, failure states and automated reachability checks.

capabilities.name: Game-aware world model
capabilities.build_note: Ground generation and agents in authoritative world state rather than unconstrained model guesses.

capabilities.name: Multi-model routing and fallback
capabilities.build_note: Select models by latency, cost, privacy, capability and eval score with deterministic fallback and provider isolation.

capabilities.name: 2D asset pipeline
capabilities.build_note: Generate/import sprites, textures, atlases and UI art with provenance, optimization and variant management.

capabilities.name: 3D asset pipeline
capabilities.build_note: Generate/import meshes with topology, LOD, collision, rig and platform-budget validation.

capabilities.name: Materials and shaders
capabilities.build_note: Generate portable materials/shaders with target-specific fallbacks and visual regression evidence.

capabilities.name: Animation authoring pipeline
capabilities.build_note: Support rigging, retargeting, state machines, procedural animation and animation validation.

capabilities.name: Audio and voice pipeline
capabilities.build_note: Generate/import music, SFX and voice with rights metadata, loudness checks, localization and runtime mixing.

capabilities.name: Asset provenance and rights ledger
capabilities.build_note: Track source, model, prompt, license, transformations and release rights for every generated/imported asset.

capabilities.name: Physics integration
capabilities.build_note: Expose deterministic collision/physics primitives and generated test scenes with fixed-step validation.

capabilities.name: Navigation/pathfinding
capabilities.build_note: Generate navigation surfaces and prove path reachability under dynamic obstacles.

capabilities.name: Rendering pipeline
capabilities.build_note: Own render budgets, quality tiers, lighting, post effects and platform-specific validation.

capabilities.name: Runtime audio engine
capabilities.build_note: Provide spatial audio, buses, ducking, streaming and deterministic event bindings.

capabilities.name: Safe hot reload
capabilities.build_note: Reload scripts/content without corrupting state; fall back transactionally when migration fails.

capabilities.name: Multiplayer transport/session layer
capabilities.build_note: Provide authoritative/session models, replication, security, bandwidth budgets and integration tests.

capabilities.name: Rollback/prediction netcode
capabilities.build_note: Support deterministic rollback, client prediction and reconciliation for latency-sensitive gameplay.

capabilities.name: Matchmaking/lobbies
capabilities.build_note: Offer lobbies, invites, skill/region policies, abuse controls and load-tested session placement.

capabilities.name: Dedicated server build
capabilities.build_note: Produce headless authoritative server artifacts with autoscaling and deterministic compatibility checks.

capabilities.name: Multi-platform export
capabilities.build_note: Make desktop/mobile/web/headless exports first-class, reproducible and validated on real target matrices.

capabilities.name: Console readiness boundary
capabilities.build_note: Keep console-specific SDK work isolated while enforcing compatible input, memory, performance and packaging contracts.

capabilities.name: XR/immersive creation
capabilities.build_note: Support XR interaction, comfort, rendering budgets and device capability detection.

capabilities.name: Incremental/cached builds
capabilities.build_note: Hash build inputs, cache outputs by content, and rebuild only affected graph nodes locally and in CI.

capabilities.name: Parallel build farm
capabilities.build_note: Fan out asset, test and target builds with deterministic aggregation and resource-aware scheduling.

capabilities.name: Reproducible release artifacts
capabilities.build_note: Pin toolchains, record inputs and verify release artifacts can be reproduced independently.

capabilities.name: Autonomous playtesting
capabilities.build_note: Run agents against builds to find soft locks, exploits, broken goals, pacing problems and regressions.

capabilities.name: Deterministic replay
capabilities.build_note: Capture inputs/state hashes so gameplay failures can be reproduced and bisected exactly.

capabilities.name: Performance budgets and profiling
capabilities.build_note: Gate CPU/GPU/memory/load-time/frame-time budgets per target and track regressions over time.

capabilities.name: Visual regression testing
capabilities.build_note: Compare deterministic scene captures across changes and quality tiers.

capabilities.name: AI/game quality eval harness
capabilities.build_note: Score generation validity, editability, fun proxies, latency, cost, safety and regression against versioned datasets.

capabilities.name: Generated code/tool sandbox
capabilities.build_note: Run generated code/tools with deny-by-default capabilities, quotas and auditable network/filesystem boundaries.

capabilities.name: Supply-chain integrity
capabilities.build_note: Track dependency risk, pinned actions/toolchains, artifact provenance and verified release inputs.

capabilities.name: Generated content safety/IP checks
capabilities.build_note: Check generated text/code/assets for policy, secrets, malware, licensing and user-defined content constraints.

capabilities.name: Realtime collaborative creation
capabilities.build_note: Coordinate multi-user editing with conflict-aware scene/design graph operations and durable audit history.

capabilities.name: Semantic merge for generated game state
capabilities.build_note: Merge scenes/design graphs/assets by semantics rather than raw text whenever possible and surface irreducible conflicts.

capabilities.name: Game telemetry and analytics
capabilities.build_note: Capture privacy-aware gameplay funnels, performance, errors and economy signals with schema/version governance.

capabilities.name: Live experiments/feature flags
capabilities.build_note: Safely stage features/content with cohorts, rollback, guardrails and causal analysis hooks.

capabilities.name: Economy/live content tooling
capabilities.build_note: Version/balance currencies, rewards, shops and live content with simulation and exploit checks.

capabilities.name: Plugin/tool extension SDK
capabilities.build_note: Let external tools/models/assets extend the platform through stable capability-scoped contracts.

capabilities.name: Player modding pipeline
capabilities.build_note: Package sandboxed mods/UGC with dependency, signing, compatibility and moderation boundaries.

capabilities.name: Localization pipeline
capabilities.build_note: Extract, translate, validate and hot-update text/voice/assets across locales with context preservation.

capabilities.name: Accessibility-first generation
capabilities.build_note: Generate input, UI, caption, contrast, motion and assist options as build requirements rather than post-processing.
